intent: Supply-chain hardening in response to the 2026-08-04 npm infostealer worm (444+ packages incl. keyv@6.0.0/cacheable@2.5.1; executes via install lifecycle hooks; steals cloud/GitHub credentials). Audit of this machine and all org lockfiles found no exposure. This adds .npmrc ignore-scripts=true so install hooks never execute here: the gate CLI is npx-invoked into consumer repos, making its dependency install surface a cross-repo blast radius. esbuild (the only script-bearing dev dep) works without its postinstall via optionalDependencies platform binaries — full suite green.

validation_plan.reason: Full suite under ignore-scripts (npm ci ran clean without lifecycle hooks).

execution_evidence.output_ref: 325 tests, 325 pass, 0 fail after npm ci with ignore-scripts=true

result_summary: plumbline installs execute no third-party lifecycle scripts; a future compromised transitive dependency cannot run code at install time on producer machines or CI.
